title: Conditional κ = 0.001600770286423653: joint prefixes in all 72 complex calls
body:

The 63 existing providers reproduce [#571](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/571)'s canonical word and both program hashes exactly. Four helper swaps per remaining call preserve every physical slot, owner window, offset and complete family; exactly 72 of 36,288 helper labels change. Complete accounting improves the global profile by Ã¢Ë†â€™108e2 + 72e3 with rank mass 520704, live stock 7168 and physical stock 7682 unchanged.

### Validation

The self-contained standard-library verifier reconstructs the retained baseline, both complete providers and the literal owner assignment from pinned source inputs. Completed, source-frozen Windows 3.14 and Linux 3.12 replay receipts are retained in research/complex-joint-prefix-validation.

- All 728 scalar columns, both reflected programs, dirty restoration, native frames and normalized wrappers.
- 135 fresh kernel omission cases per provider, eight final rank-five omissions, and 15 independent literal-prefix/coverage mutations per provider.
- All 2928/3004 directed phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters per provider, including global phase.
- Complete physical owner admission, a fresh finite cost invoice, seven packing mutations, 16 controller mutations and 93 assembly mutations.
- Both exact rational moment engines, seven bootstrap steps, all 47 strict outer inequalities in each model, and rejection of the adjacent exponent grid points.
- Recompression, semantic-identity and reference mutation controls. Exact claims and all seven generated provider identities agree across both runtimes.

The previously completed 18-group mandatory repository baseline is retained with a source comparison establishing applicability to the unchanged baseline. It is identified as reused evidence, not a new full-suite execution. The [#543](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/543) bit profile is repriced with its surcharge retained; its bit circuit is not freshly rebuilt.

### Sources and scope

[#571](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/571) supplies the literal 57-gate prefix, complete width-seven composition and source owner geometry; [#568](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/568) supplies the eight cold kernels; [#569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/569) supplies paid width-seven entrances; [#567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/567) supplies portable replay and artifact-identity work. Immutable sources, licenses, original contributor credits and AI disclosures are preserved. The new nine-call extension, independent audits and packaging were prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance under Apache-2.0.

All inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, normalized interfaces, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1-H5 obligations remain conditional. This is a stronger finite witness, not an unconditional multiplication theorem or a measured practical speedup. The historical selected certificate is unchanged.

Reproduce from the repository root:

~~~sh
python3 -B research/complex-joint-prefix/verify.py --work /tmp/joint-prefix-replay
~~~
